run_train_clip: run a CLIP model training job with LoRA adapters on densely captioned image datasets
CLIPAndNegConfig: create a training configuration dataclass with LoRA, dataset, loss, and sampling hyperparameters
get_dir_name: build a descriptive output directory name string from a CLIPAndNegConfig object
CLIPTrainJob: create a submitit job wrapper to queue and checkpoint CLIP training runs
config_store: register the CLIPAndNegConfig dataclass with Hydra for CLI-based training execution
